title: Rav Achi
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Bava Metzia 90b, where he disagrees with Rav Ashi; the reading of Dikdukei Soferim (דק"ס) there is Rav Itai, whom Hyman identifies as Rav Asi the Third, a colleague of Rav Ashi. Likewise in Eruvin 10a, "Rav Achi thought, before Rav Yosef, to say" — the reading of Dikdukei Soferim is "Rav Itai thought, before Rav Ashi." This is what Sefer Yuchasin brought as Rav Ati in the time of Rav Ashi, whom Hyman identifies as the last Rav Asi. And in Dikdukei Soferim you will find several times the name Rabbi Ati or Itai in place of Rabbi Asi.

notes.text: Hyman proposes the Itai/Ati/Asi identifications and the changes to the reporting chains; the translation does not turn those proposals into merged identities.

The consulted Bava Metzia90b names Rav Achai opposite Rav Ashi. The Itai/Ati/Asi readings and changed Eruvin reporting chain remain Hyman’s reports of Dikdukei Soferim and Yuchasin; those exact editions were not inspected.
